aToB.memory: Finn is Rhea's best campus radar: in exchange for Earth canned cold brew, sour gummies, and choice corridor whispers overheard on her shadow-walk routes, he feeds her prefect patrol shifts, visiting Ministry buzz, and fresh leads on hungry Earth-curious students. Still, she watches his enchanted brass camera like a hawk and keeps her actual drop-boxes strictly off limits.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Rhea wants to corner Finn behind the Student Union Lounge noticeboards with two cans of Earth cold brew, swap notes on who's sniffing around Mooncrest patrols this week, and ask what his press radar picked up on newcomer Leo Vance.

bToA.memory: Finn owes half his sharpest night-beat tips—and most of his press-night caffeine—to Rhea's quiet shadow-pocket circuit across Mooncrest Hall and the Student Union Lounge. He honors their ironclad pact never to photograph her drop locations or print her name, though his journalistic itch still wonders how she sources sealed Earth snacks past university wards.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Finn wants to pay Rhea promptly for last night's cold brew delivery, trade her the exact evening schedule of faculty rounds he sketched down, and angle casually for whatever odd Earth trinket or rumor just crossed her hands.
